name_reason: Trailing _52381 equals the symbol's own address (0x52381) -- a Ghidra address residue, prohibited by naming rules. The descriptor 'bg_dat' already uniquely identifies the BG.DAT filename, so the address suffix is redundant. Dropping it matches the cleaner sibling resource-filename strings in the same file (data_fd2_string_resource_filename_fdtxt_dat, _fdother_dat, _fdmus_dat, _tai_dat, _figani_dat... -- note several siblings still carry stale address suffixes too). Stays compliant: data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>, reflects data type (string) and role (resource filename).
purpose: Read-only NUL-terminated ASCII string "BG.DAT"; the resource filename passed as the first (char* path) argument to fd2_load_dat_resource to open the parallax-background archive BG.DAT.
logic_summary: Static const char[7] = {'B','G','.','D','A','T',0}. Address-taken (array decays to char*) and handed to fd2_load_dat_resource by the battle combat/spell/skill cinematic routines. Callers load index 0/1/2 to populate the three parallax background planes (data_fd2_battle_special_cinematic_bg_layers[0..2] @ 0x5410B/0F/13) and load a terrain-specific index (the tile attribute byte at the caster position) for the per-battle background. Never modified by the game.
element_semantics: Bytes 0..5 = ASCII 'B','G','.','D','A','T'; byte 6 = 0x00 NUL terminator. The whole array is one C string used as a DOS filename path.
notes: is_const verified by xrefs: all 16 references to 0x52381 are [DATA] (address-taken), located in fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic, fd2_play_spell_cast_cinematic, fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence, fd2_execute_special_attack_skill, fd2_play_figani_char_intro_animation, fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast; decompilation of fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast (0x28073) and fd2_execute_special_attack_skill (0x27886) confirms the value is only consumed as the char* path arg to fd2_load_dat_resource, never written; src already declares const char[7]. Ghidra data plate at 0x52381 was null -> created via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT (Java API, per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism). src comment block (strtab.c lines 154-163) already precise/accurate/ASCII -> kept unchanged; only file change this shard is the shard json itself. rename deferred to Stage 2 (touches globals.h declaration + all call sites).
